{{Quote|This is the Darrow sphere, I created it myself to help student training here at Stav Kesh, and this is the only one. A student of mine several years ago called it Je’daii’s bane, and I almost changed its name. I like that. And like anything with two names, the sphere has its ambiguities.|[[Kin'ade]]|<ref name="ItV"/>}}
The '''Darrow sphere''', also known as "'''Je'daii's bane'''", was a device invented by [[Je'daii Master]] [[Kin'ade]] to assist in training [[Je'daii]] [[Youngling/Legends|students]] at [[Stav Kesh]]. It was a predecessor to the [[Remote/Legends|training remote]].<ref name="ItV"/>

==Characteristics==
The physical appearance of the Darrow sphere seemed to vary, with it being able to have a smooth, fluid surface as well as hard and spiked surface. It also had the ability to change size, at least varying from a size larger than a [[Human/Legends|human]] head to about the size of a human fist. The sphere could glow, with one possible glow color being [[Color/Legends|blue]]. The sphere could become transparent, and perhaps even entirely invisible. The sphere made a humming noise.<ref name="ItV"/>

When active, the sphere [[Repulsorlift/Legends|hovered]], and attacked trainees by firing at them and bashing into them physically. The shots fired by the sphere were able to cause pain and muscle spasms, and the force of the sphere's impact could knock [[Lanoree Brock]] onto her back. The sphere could also electrocute an opponent if they made physical contact with the sphere.<ref name="ItV"/>

==History==
The Darrow sphere was a singular device invented by Je'daii Master [[Kin'ade]]. Several years before [[25,802 BBY]], a [[Unidentified Je'daii student|student]] of Kin'ade named the sphere "Je'daii's bane".<ref name="ItV"/>

In 25,802 BBY, during Lanoree and [[Dalien Brock|Dalien Brock's]] stay at Stav Kesh, they took part in a training session with the Darrow sphere. During an initial spar, Lanoree and the other students were quickly defeated, with one [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] student being able to get a physical hit in before being electrocuted.<ref name="ItV"/>

After this, Lanoree and the other students were [[Blindfold|blindfolded]], had their [[Earplug|ears plugged]], and their [[Nose clip|noses clipped]], removing their senses of sight, hearing, and smell. After she was defeated, the other students went after, with Dalien going last. Unable to rely on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Dalien was struck in the leg in the sphere, before he removed a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] from his [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]] and fired it wildly in an attempt to hit the sphere. In response, Master Kin'ade used a [[Telekinesis/Legends|force push]] to throw Dalien across the room, causing him to hit his head and lose consciousness.<ref name="ItV"/>
